game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine, an ancient fire shrine: the ash ranger must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Fire Shrine open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine: an ancient fire shrine
core_gameplay_loop: In Fire Shrine, repeat each round: Use % to decide which gates in Fire Shrine open (even, odd, divisible by 3). Each round, a new heat shields challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the gates_open value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 380 points of heat shields by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 380, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Modulo Gate
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Fire Shrine'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gates_open changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Fire Shrine.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 380 within 51 seconds.
